Clause-②: no (tests only)

Premise (seat, read on main `c2922e4e4`): both reds are tests that lag intended merges, the same shape as #35762.
- `lint-strict-warnings.e2e.test.ts:283`: the `clean` fixture now draws one finding, `total` 1. That finding is `relationship/line-items-inline-edit` (suggestion): since #35921 (#35889 S1), an `inlineEdit: true` FK no longer satisfies R5; only a parent field group that places the child does (`packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts:1209`). The fixture child `cln_line` matches the line-item name pattern and its parent has no field group. Fix the fixture, not the rule: when `adviseMaster` is on, the parent `${ns}_invoice` also declares a field group placing `${ns}_line` (or an equivalent knob), so `clean` is 0/0/0 again and `suggests` keeps its two suggestions. Re-measure every row of the fixture table in the file's header and update the table and the `stack()` doc comment if a count moves.
- `detail-shapes.spec.ts:100` and `:200`: both wait for `[aria-label="Record path"]`, the stage strip #35938 removed from the default record page (epic #35590). The spec drops the stage-strip and highlight-strip expectations to match today's default page, keeping what each test still pins (field-group sections, Money collapsed, flat details, related panels).
Basis: card #36007 (p1, bug, generated by the nightly), routed to this seat by triage (7058815240). Both causes are merges from the epics this seat holds (#35889 under #35896, #35938 under #35590), so it is a derived p1 bug under the maintainer's 2026-11-20 22:31Z order.
Scope: the two test files above. Measure: run the CLI e2e file and the showcase live spec (`detail-shapes.spec.ts`) locally, the same way the nightly tier runs them; paste the result in the PR.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. The `detail-shapes.spec.ts` hunk moves here from #35978 (claim 7058540066, amended on that card), so the p1 red is not held by #35978's i18n question. The PR carries `Fixes #36007`.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim amendment: PM loop · 2026-11-21T08:20Z (amends this card's claim)
File surface, widened: the console live specs the nightly's same command runs, which went red after the nightly at `98b3f87e` and before main `141a826f`: `form-view-subforms`, `grid-conditional-rules`, `grid-file-upload` and `grid-parent-rules` (4 of 28). All four wait for a Qty input in the first line-items row and find none. Suspects: #35998 (the line grid no longer draws a blank entry row beside Add, an intended change) or #35984 (#35940, new lines take the child's defaults). The area first decides which. If the specs assumed the removed blank row, they are fixed in PR #36028 (click Add, then fill the new row), and this card's `Fixes` covers them so tonight's nightly is not red again. If a product path broke, the area tells the seat before changing anything, and the seat files a bug card. Everything else in the claim stands.
